description.zh:
1936 年 10 月，红四方面军一部奉中革军委命令西渡黄河，后组建西路军，在河西走廊艰苦转战。本专题以渡河、古浪、高台、倪家营子、梨园口、石窝会议 6 个节点，呈现西路军从组建到分散游击的历程。

> 本数据为初稿：路线为示意简化，事件日期、地点与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
In October 1936, part of the Fourth Front Army crossed the Yellow River on the orders of the Central Military Commission and was later organized as the West Route Army, fighting a hard campaign in the Hexi Corridor. This atlas covers six nodes: the river crossing, Gulang, Gaotai, Nijia Yingzi, Liyuankou, and the Shiwo meeting.

> Draft data: routes are simplified; event dates, places, and wording await historical review.

name.zh: 西路军（红四方面军一部）
name.en: West Route Army (part of the Fourth Front Army)

description.zh: 由红四方面军第 5、9、30 军及总部直属部队组成，共 2.18 万余人。
description.en: Formed from the Fourth Front Army’s 5th, 9th, and 30th armies and headquarters units, totaling more than 21,800 troops.
